thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for customer VelaHealth on dedicated-cluster eu-west-2-ded-3. Error rate > 8% over 5m window, connection resets and gateway timeouts observed. Pager: Maya.

Maya: picked this up, joining. quick sanity check: is this localized to a single tenant pool or broad?

Jun: looking. initial metric: 5xx spike correlated with high KV eviction rate on node group ded-nodepool-7. connection resets around same time.

Maya: good to know. Rachel, fyi — customer could be impacted, please stand by for impact estimate.

Rachel: on it. VelaHealth reported intermittent failures to submit telemetry a few minutes ago. Support is seeing ~25% failed requests in the last 10m on their dashboard.

Tom: pulling gpu/runtime metrics now. I see one host (ded-7a-02) with 98% memory util and heavy page-in activity, others are normal. KV cache miss rate up 4x.

Dylan: support confirms customer traffic didn't spike on their side. Looks like noisy tenant or KV thrash on our side.

Maya: prioritize mitigation: 1) route VelaHealth to standby pool 2) throttle suspected noisy tenant if found 3) enable graceful fallback to smaller model variant for VelaHealth to reduce memory/KV pressure. Who can run the reroute?

Jun: I can trigger route override. will page infra to add capacity later. Doing a quick dry-run of reroute; will flip traf-router policy for customer vela-prod to pool ded-standby-eu.

Jun: running command:
```
# reroute customer traffic to standby pool
curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/v1/routing/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"customer_id":"vela-prod","target_pool":"ded-standby-eu","reason":"live mitigation - elevated 5xx"}'
```

Jun: override applied. Control plane reports 87% of new requests flowing to ded-standby-eu. Monitoring...

infra-bot: autoscale event triggered for ded-nodepool-7 -> requested +2 nodes (provisioning). ETA ~6m.

Maya: checking error rates now. Jun, what's the 5xx after reroute?

Jun: 5xx dropped from 8.3% to 1.7% on new requests. Overall still ~4.5% because of in-flight sessions on ded-7.

Tom: starting a live remediation on ded-7a-02: will drain heavy worker processes and restart the runtime instance to clear KV fragmentation.

Tom: drain command:
```
# drain node
kubectl cordon node/ded-7a-02
kubectl drain node/ded-7a-02 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
kubectl delete pod -l runtime=node-ded-7a-02
```

Tom: restart issued. observing eviction logs:
```
[2026-03-15T01:23:45Z] kv_cache: eviction count=18321, hit_rate=0.12, mem_usage=96%
[2026-03-15T01:24:10Z] conn_reset: remote=10.8.2.14:57422, reason=backpressure
```

Dylan: customer still has some failed requests but majority are routing to standby. I've updated the VelaHealth ticket: short blip, worked around by routing.

Maya: good. Ops-lead, any concerns with keeping override active while we stabilize?

ops-lead: keep override for 30m after metrics stable <1% 5xx, then gradual flip back with canary. Also want postmortem to check for noisy neighbor and KV sizing.

Jun: agreed. I'll keep an eye on KV eviction thresholds and schedule a resize for ded-nodepool-7 if trend continues. One oddity: we saw sustained small requests with large prefix variance — might indicate a customer-side bursty workload causing KV churn.

Rachel: I've asked VelaHealth PM to provide recent client release notes. if they did a rollout, that could explain prefix changes. Support is on a call with them.

infra-bot: autoscale completed. +2 nodes active in ded-nodepool-7.

Tom: node restart completed. KV mem dropped to 62%, eviction rate trending down. connection_resets near zero on that host.

Jun: 5xx now at 0.9% overall for VelaHealth traffic. Standby pool handling okay.

Maya: moving to impact assessment: Customer-facing error rate peaked ~8.3% for ~12 minutes with ~25% request failures observed on their dashboard in that window. No data loss reported, primarily request retries/failures.

Rachel: support update — VelaHealth reported degraded UX for telemetry ingestion, they opened an internal incident but not a production outage. They will monitor.

Dylan: I've offered to whitelist additional logs if they share a request id, and provided a temporary SLA note.

Maya: next steps: - keep route override for 30m post-stable - schedule nodepool resize & KV tuning ticket - postmortem + RCA - check model-variant fallback logic and ensure it's auto-triggerable for future KV pressure events - notify account team and legal if SLA credit likely

Jun: filing ticket INF-4789: evaluate KV cache sizing, eviction policy, and routing heuristics for prefix churn. Assigned to eng-runtime. ETA 3 days for initial triage.

Tom: I'll follow up on infra side for nodepool autoscale policy changes to avoid single-node heavy pressure. Ticket INF-4790.

Maya: handing off to night oncall Jun-2 (Jun is staying). I'll summarize in the handoff: VelaHealth elevated 5xx due to KV eviction + noisy memory host; mitigated via routing override to standby, node restart, autoscale. Metrics stable 30m after actions. Keep override until 32:20 UTC (30m post-stable).

Jun: will continue watch and will alert if 5xx > 1% or KV eviction spikes.

Maya: thanks everyone. postmortem owners: Jun (runtime), Tom (infra), Rachel (customer comms).

oncall-bot: NOTE: Handoff recorded. Incident severity: sev3. Automatically created incident ticket INC-2026-842 with attached graphs.

Rachel: I'll draft a customer note: summary, mitigation, and ask if they'd like a call.

Dylan: support will follow up and close the VelaHealth ticket once they confirm client stability.

Maya: closing thread for now, keeping watchers. if anything flares, reopen or ping @channel. :thumbsup:

Jun: quick log snapshot for postmortem attachment:
```
2026-03-15T01:20:12Z ERROR gateway: upstream_5xx for req_id=abc123 customer=vela-prod code=502 host=ded-7a-02
2026-03-15T01:20:15Z WARN kv_cache: eviction spike threshold breached count=1200 window=60s
2026-03-15T01:22:01Z INFO routing: override applied customer=vela-prod -> ded-standby-eu
2026-03-15T01:26:40Z INFO node: ded-7a-02 restarted, kv_mem=62%, evictions=30/min
```
Maya: thanks — attaching these to INC-2026-842. end of thread.
